scope_amendments.reason: A small module beside the existing Hint/navigation owner holds the closed local grammar, scope-to-collector mapping, candidate-kind filters, and direct Target Search dispatcher.

The command must enter only through local command dispatch and be rejected from expanded IPC command chains; the existing shared external Hint-interaction guard keeps browser_ui_ipc.rs within its 1,000-line module budget.
SearchWithin must reuse the existing region lease receipt, owner/session/revision validation, descendant collector, and Hint session lifecycle while recording the original source family.
The Qt/QML boundary needs bounded ephemeral Target Search state and a cancellation invokable; the query and selection remain presentation state.
The native palette, explicit confirmation, focus capture/restoration, visible-only refresh, and stale-session invalidation span the runtime component call chain.
The collector needs opt-in region/surface facets without changing legacy all behavior, and the native result projection needs exact identity/action-meaning reconciliation without retaining raw URLs.
The Target Search behavior and local-only command scope must be documented in the Guide and regenerated command reference.

Existing Rust, IPC codec, Qt Quick, and WebEngine suites need assertions for ranking reuse, local/remote provenance, privacy, scoped collection, explicit confirmation, and virtualized selection behavior.
